criteria.section: L4-OW / Working purpose; Consultation and verification
criteria.reason: Defines the bounded ownership job and routes questions by need.
Separates provenance, visibility, coordination, and provider outcome before assignment.
Assigns decisions to contract boundaries without inventing organizational owners.
Distinguishes intent, implementation, authority, currentness, and missing proof.
Defines a version-bound decision and handoff receipt with verification reach and unresolved obligations.
The resume:false example selects a premise, assigns the decision, and stops without claiming processing.
Orders compatibility assessment, classification, consultation, editing, verification, and handoff; permits scoped source inspection.
Separates retry and projection gates, provenance paths, and sequence-carrier checks.
Provides ordering, allowance, transformation, coordination, keying, and placement checks with explicit mapping limits.
Maps change categories to supplied assertion reach and gives a bounded context/time decision without inventing test failures.
Distinguishes compatible rebinding from changed support requiring revalidation and preserves unchanged valid understanding.
Specifies completion fields, verification reach, knowledge updates, and explicit stops.
Provides the public submission contract, required inputs, delivery choices, and acknowledgment limits.
Prescribes identity-preserving retry, warns of wake effects, and distinguishes conflict and historical reconciliation.
Separates observations and applies the distinct steer, continuation, idle, and queue conditions before diagnosis.
Describes interruption and restart limits as intended rather than runtime-proven, without unsafe recovery claims.
Gives an authorized normal-use example and a bounded incident path with observable completion or precise handoff.
The receipt captures intent, identity, provenance, observations, decisions, version bindings, and missing evidence.
Routes ownership, maintenance, and operational work within the bounded research scope.
A need-first table selects exact supplied L3 handles and sections without requiring sibling skills.
Requires a named premise for deeper consultation and stops on missing, mismatched, or stale bindings.

criteria.section: L4-SK / Consultation and verification; Boundaries and escalation
criteria.reason: Keeps authority, security, currentness, verification, and recovery limits distinct while permitting edit-time source reads.
Shows a shallow operational decision and a deeper maintenance/ownership decision with explicit unresolved premises.

criteria.section: L4-SK / Boundaries and escalation; Coverage and gaps
criteria.reason: Names production integration, scoped reading, and consumer evaluation as separate needs without self-certifying global completion.

permittedUnknowns: Runtime interleavings, atomicity, provider-request inclusion and interrupted provider completion or usage remain unproven.
Deployment credentials, authorization, current runtime observations and some incident-specific internal observations are not supplied.
Hosted or distributed execution, provider-crash retry, automatic replay and production publication are outside the established scope.
Independent layer acceptance, consumer evaluation and governed publication remain separate from this candidate judgment.
